interpretation: Published values are descriptive historical controls. Only baseline/current share the validated workload, device/CPU/NUMA, precision and timing boundary. Repeat ranges and MAD are empirical detection floors, not permitted regression percentages or confidence intervals. Any stable increase or added synchronization requires investigation, including small increases within the observed range. Three repeats do not establish a tail-latency distribution. Memory samples are not process peaks; cache accounting is separate.
